data.description:
## Context / Problem

Private reconciler forwarding bindings retain a second owner after moves: `apply_inbound_records._inbound_update_write_edit_event` forwards to `apply_inbound_events`; `reconcile` forwards listed pass helpers to `reconcile_helpers`/runtime; and `Mode.rank()` remains only because comparison dunders call it. The governing ADR is delivered by earthen-wheat-chick.

## Approach

After the ADR merges, migrate every source/test/string/dynamic/monkeypatch consumer to `apply_inbound_events`, `reconcile_helpers`, or runtime. Rewrite Mode comparisons to use the natural comparison dunders without `rank()`, then remove the old private bindings. Recensus on the implementation base before deletion.

## Scope

- inbound event-write compatibility re-export
- reconciler pass-helper/runtime re-exports
- `Mode.rank()` and comparison callers
- all static and dynamic consumers

## Testing

Run semantic reference lookup plus raw string/`getattr`/monkeypatch scans; run inbound, orchestration, and mode-order tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every old core/reconciler private name has no production, test, string, dynamic-load, or monkeypatch consumer.
- [ ] The canonical owner is the only binding for each migrated operation.
- [ ] Mode ordering comparisons retain all current ordering semantics without `rank()`.
- [ ] Focused inbound/orchestration/mode tests and full scans pass.
data.title: Migrate and remove core and reconciler internal shims
